text:
Alex: quick async — what I did / blockers / today
Alex: What I did: landed PR #4823 (batcher: reduce kernel lock contention). ran a small perf sweep across canary; p95 improved ~12%. pushed image redwood/batcher:canary-4823
Alex: Blockers: seeing intermittent KV miss spikes on long-sequence traces from canary (attaching logs). unsure if it's eviction threshold or our prefetch alignment.
Alex: Today: investigate KV miss patterns, add more logging around slot assignment, follow up on rollout schedule for the canary.
Maya: saw the same spikes in prod-mirror yesterday morning. I think some tenants with long prompts are hitting a slot-steal pattern.
Maya: quick hint — try bumping prefetched_slots from 8->12 in the runtime config on the canary node and re-run the trace.
Sam: pinging on the PR code review: left comments on the lock lifetime and a potential race when canceling a batch. small nits but 2 are safety-related.
Sam: also, can you add a microbenchmark that simulates 8k token prefixes? helps repro the KV miss rate in CI.
Alex: @Sam saw comments, will address race and add benchmark. thanks.
Jin: ops-bot reported a transient OOM on canary-3 at 03:12 UTC, same time as a heavy tail of very long requests. logs:
Jin: ```
2025-10-18T03:12:11Z canary-3 kernel: evict triggered, free=2.4GB, request_seq=8201
2025-10-18T03:12:11Z canary-3 batcher: slot-steal detected for tenant t-9c7, length=8132
2025-10-18T03:12:11Z canary-3 runtime: allocation failed: want 6.2GB, avail 2.1GB
```
Jin: Ops-bot says it auto-restarted kernel process and recovered. no customer impact reported.
ops-bot: Incident note: auto-restart succeeded (canary-3), time to recovery 27s, flags set: kernel_restart=true, increased logging=true
Maya: if the bloat is from large KV pages because of long sequences we may want to cap cached prefix per-tenant during canary, e.g., set max_prefetch_bytes=40MB temporarily.
Alex: good call. I'll add a runtime flag to cap tenant cache in canary and re-run benchmark.
Sam: For the microbenchmark, use this harness snippet in bench/kv_stress.py:
Sam: ```python
# bench/kv_stress.py (pseudo)
def run(n_requests=200, seq_len=8000):
    for i in range(n_requests):
        req = make_request(seq_len=seq_len, tenant=random_tenant())
        send_to_canary(req)
```
Sam: that'll reproduce the tail. add it to CI perf matrix at least as a gated job.
Alex: will add test and push a fix for the race. aiming EOD for the quick patch, otherwise tomorrow morning.
Jin: FYI I'm going to pin canary traffic to region-us-east-2 for the next 2 hours while we iterate.
Maya: +1. let us know if you want me to flip the prefetch flag or I can hand off to infra.
Alex: please flip prefetch_slots to 12 and set max_prefetch_bytes=40MB on canary-3. ops-bot, can you annotate the rollout?
ops-bot: Annotated: config_change by Maya at 2025-10-18T09:05:12Z (prefetch_slots=12, max_prefetch_bytes=40MB) — rollout to canary-3 only.
Maya: done. re-running the slow trace now. baseline run queued.
Alex: thanks. if the miss rate drops we can promote PR and schedule a wider canary.
Sam: added a test plan comment on the PR about validating no perf regression on short sequences (<512 tokens).
Jin: once Alex pushes, I'll watch canary metrics (kv_miss_rate, kernel_free_mem, p95_latency) and post graphs here.
Alex: excellent. blockers unblocked for now — will update thread after benchmark. small follow-up: need a perf dashboard tile for 'kv_miss_rate by tenant_tier' — filing a Grafana ticket after this.
Maya: small FYI: I spotted a typo in the benchmark harness — sending a quick patch to your branch.
Alex: nice, thanks.
Sam: LGTM on the tenant cap idea, but we should add a config lint to prevent accidental high values in prod.
Alex: noted. adding lint + test. will update thread with final numbers. :rocket:
